chunks: And in the narration of Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
If a woman apostasizes from Islam, she is not to be killed, but rather she is to be imprisoned forever.

key_terms.ارْتَدَّتِ: she reverted from Islam through apostasy
key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: the religion from which apostasy occurred

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in this hadith on a woman who apostasizes from Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the case of a woman who apostasizes from Islam. It states that she is not to be executed, but instead is to remain imprisoned permanently.
